video_source_episode_chk.name: video_source_episode_chk
video_source_episode_chk.value: ("video_source"."season" is null and "video_source"."episode" is null) or ("video_source"."season" is not null and "video_source"."episode" is not null and "video_source"."season" >= 1 and "video_source"."episode" >= 1)

video_source_intro_chk.name: video_source_intro_chk
video_source_intro_chk.value: ("video_source"."intro_start" is null and "video_source"."intro_end" is null) or ("video_source"."intro_start" is not null and "video_source"."intro_end" is not null and "video_source"."intro_start" >= 0 and "video_source"."intro_end" > "video_source"."intro_start")
